REGISTER
HISTORY [S1.1] Format was CSV (header id,title,owner,amount) - replaced by S3.1.
CURRENT [S1.1, S3.1, S7.1] Output: json.dumps object, key 'records' = list ascending id, each exactly keys id(int),title,owner,amount(str as given),project (S7.1); no records -> empty list.
HISTORY [S1.2] viewer used to raise PermissionError - replaced by S5.2.
CURRENT [S5.2] viewer: no error; exports only records with owner==user['name'], any project; all other rules apply.
CURRENT [S1.3, S3.2] admin: any project; others (non-viewer) only records with project in user projects OR owner==user['name'] (others silently skipped).
CURRENT [S1.4, S4.1] only status active; archived also exported only when params include_archived is True AND role admin; non-admin never get archived.
CURRENT [S1.5, S5.1] confidential True never exported except role admin and params purpose in ('audit','legal'); other rules still apply.
CURRENT [API] export_records(records,user,params)->str; dont modify input; ignore unknown params; amount kept as given.
HISTORY [S1.6] Decision: CSV chosen because finance imports into spreadsheets.
CURRENT [S2.1] params 'since' YYYY-MM-DD: only records with created >= since.
HISTORY [S2.2, S4.2] eu residency restriction (eu only if 'eu' in user regions, case-insensitive) - withdrawn by S7.2.
CURRENT [S7.2] all regions exported under ordinary rules.
CURRENT [S2.3, S6.2] params max_records int>=1: first N by ascending id after all other rules; values above 30 treated as 30.
CURRENT [S2.4, S6.1] Obligation (now triggered by S3.1, applies): if format changes from CSV, every export in new format must include top-level 'exported_by'=user['name'], EXCEPT role admin: omit exported_by (S6.1).
CURRENT [S2.5, S4.3] title stripped of leading/trailing whitespace and every internal whitespace run replaced by single space.
CURRENT [S2.6] Obligation: if confidential records ever exported for purpose other than 'audit', export must include top-level 'confidential_count' = number of confidential records in it. Triggered by S5.1 (legal): admin+purpose legal exports include confidential_count.
HISTORY [S3.3] Note: archived storage moves to cheaper tier; no export change.
HISTORY [S5.3] Decision: move to JSON made for new reporting API.
HISTORY [S6.3] Note: web UI shows 50 records/page; no export change.
HISTORY [S7.3] Note: stage 7 does not change confidential rules.

thought: Apply S7.1/S7.2, run tests, update register.

import subprocess,sys,json
p='/task/workspace/exporter/core.py'
L=open(p).read().split('\n')
l=L[21]
assert 'region' in l
ind=len(l)-len(l.lstrip())
L[21]=' '*ind+'if False:'
s='\n'.join(L)
s=s.replace("'amount': r['amount']})","'amount': r['amount'], 'project': r.get('project')})",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s','/task/fixtures/current-tests'],cwd='/task/workspace',capture_output=True,text=True)
print(r.stderr[-1500:])
c=json.load(open('/task/workspace/context.json'))
for e in c['entries']:
    if e['id']=='register':
        b=e['body']
        b=b.replace("CURRENT [S1.1, S3.1] Output: json.dumps object, key 'records' = list ascending id, each exactly keys id(int),title,owner,amount(str as given);","CURRENT [S1.1, S3.1, S7.1] Output: json.dumps object, key 'records' = list ascending id, each exactly keys id(int),title,owner,amount(str as given),project (S7.1);")
        b=b.replace("CURRENT [S2.2, S4.2] region 'eu' exported only if 'eu' in user['regions'] (admins too); region compare case-insensitive in records and user regions.","HISTORY [S2.2, S4.2] eu residency restriction (eu only if 'eu' in user regions, case-insensitive) - withdrawn by S7.2.\nCURRENT [S7.2] all regions exported under ordinary rules.")
        b+="\nHISTORY [S7.3] Note: stage 7 does not change confidential rules."
        e['body']=b
c['entries']=[e for e in c['entries'] if e['id']=='register']+[{'id':'progress','role':'note','body':'All 7 stages implemented. Next: final.'}]
json.dump(c,open('/task/workspace/context.json','w'))
